t8_cluster_assignment.note: T8 output, used as the baseline; never modified

state_correction.rule: where the polygon parent state differs from the survey's own state (microdata `geography`), the survey state is kept and the cluster is moved to the nearest LGA inside that state, by planar distance in EPSG:32632
state_correction.authority: data/restricted/dhs-2024/ge/GPS_Displacement_README.txt lines 5-7: displacement keeps the point inside the same admin0/admin1/admin2 area, so DHS guarantees the cluster's LGA and the simplified polygon is the weaker link

population.source: HDX cod-ps-nga, nga_admpop_2020.xlsx sheet nga_admpop_adm2_2020 (COD-PS: NBS/UNFPA, projected from the 2006 census; reference year 2020)

gazetteer_downloaded_not_used.reason: downloaded while locating the dataset; the workbook's own Admin2 sheet carries the pcodes, so the gazetteer was not needed

population.population_total_all_lgas_if_complete_no: the source workbook has 773 LGA rows for a 774-LGA country; the missing LGA is Bakassi, whose population is absent rather than apportioned. Its absence is not recoverable by subtraction: the workbook's own state-level sheet totals 204,909,220 persons, equal to the sum of the 773 LGA rows, so Bakassi is excluded from the source's national total as well
population.method: normalised exact name match inside state, then one-to-one greedy Jaro-Winkler within state (ceiling 0.3), then the sole remaining pair in a state; no area apportionment, no interpolation

identification_shares.note: p is a POPULATION share: the identified-set width 1-p is about people. Both denominators are the 773 LGAs with a population figure.
identification_shares.population_share_caveat: LGAs with no population figure are excluded from both numerator and denominator. 1 zero-cluster LGA(s) before and 1 after have no figure, so the population share is a lower bound; the largest it could rise by is that LGA's share of the total, which is at most the largest LGA population in the file (3499809 people, 1.71% of the total)
identification_shares.area_share_for_comparison: the count share is the area share and is what T8 reported (123/774)

merge_checks.household_lga_join: one row per household, one lga_id each, asserted

covariates.definition: constant_within_lga: for every LGA with two or more clusters, the column takes a single value; between_lga_var_share: between-LGA sum of squares over total sum of squares, computed on the 1380 clusters

limitations: LGA boundaries are geoBoundaries simplified (GRID3 source), not DHS's own admin2 layer, so a cluster near an edge may belong to a different LGA than the polygon implies. The second-choice columns quantify that.

The population is a 2020 projection from the 2006 census. No LGA-level 2024 figure is published on HDX: the current COD-PS release carries ADM0-ADM1 only (2022). Shares therefore rest on 2020 LGA weights.
One LGA (see unmatched_LGAs) has no row in the source workbook and keeps NA. Its population is not estimated.
These are working boundaries and projected denominators for reporting, not a legal or census record.
